title: Morning Brief — Friday, 23 October 2026
description: MP Helen Haines remains critical as political tributes continue, south-east Queensland begins drying out after widespread flash flooding, and a $30 million retail centre is planned beside Dreamworld on the Gold Coast. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
